description: Followup prompt template for subsequent game steps with support for numeric and natural language modes

numeric.description: AI outputs action as numeric ID (Action: 0, 1, 2...)
context_template: Step {step} - Result of your last action:
instruction_template: Choose the next action for the CURRENT STATE shown in the image above.
IMPORTANT: Your response MUST start with [Action: <number>] on the FIRST LINE.
You may add brief reasoning after.
template: Step {step} - Result of your last action:
This is the CURRENT STATE after executing your action.
What action do you choose next?
IMPORTANT: Your response MUST start with [Action: <number>] on the FIRST LINE.
You may add brief reasoning after.

natural_language.description: AI outputs action as natural language description (Action: FIRE, turn left...)
context_template: Step {step} - Result of your last action:
instruction_template: Choose the next action for the CURRENT STATE shown in the image above.
IMPORTANT: Your response MUST start with [Action: <action_name>] on the FIRST LINE.
You may add brief reasoning after.
template: Step {step} - Result of your last action:
This is the CURRENT STATE after executing your action.
What action do you choose next?
IMPORTANT: Your response MUST start with [Action: <action_name>] on the FIRST LINE.
You may add brief reasoning after.

status_templates.truncated: ⚠️ Game TRUNCATED (time limit or other constraint).

placeholders.status_info: Game status info (terminated/truncated), empty string if none
placeholders.life_info: Life lost info, empty string if none
placeholders.lives_before: Lives before last action (for life_lost template)
placeholders.lives_after: Lives after last action (for life_lost template)

notes: context_template is sent before the current-state image; instruction_template is sent after it
The template list is kept for backwards-compatible full prompt generation
status_info and life_info are pre-formatted with leading newlines in status_templates
In natural_language mode, last_action_id is not shown to AI
